title: NEB Class 11 English — Writing — 2021
subject: english
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Write a well-organised paragraph of about 100-120 words on the topic 'Causes and Effects of the Growing Use of Mobile Phones among School Students'. Follow the cause-and-effect pattern: topic sentence -> cause 1 -> effect 1 -> cause 2 -> effect 2 -> concluding sentence.
questions.solution:
**Model paragraph (111 words):**

The growing use of mobile phones among school students has become a serious concern for teachers and parents alike. The first cause is easy access: cheap data and a phone in every pocket make the internet available all day. As a result, many students now spend hours scrolling, chatting and watching short videos instead of revising their lessons, and their homework is often submitted late or half finished. A second cause is that phones have become a new way of showing social status, and peer pressure makes it hard to be the only student without one. This brings another bad effect: students feel obliged to reply to messages during class and even at night, so they sleep late and reach school tired. Unless schools set clear rules and parents set firm limits, the mobile phone will continue to weaken study rather than help it.

**Structure followed:** topic sentence -> cause (easy access) -> effect (lost study time) -> cause (peer pressure) -> effect (late sleep, tiredness) -> concluding sentence with a suggestion.
questions.knowledgeNote: In cause-and-effect paragraphs, state the topic sentence first, link each cause to its effect, and end with a concluding sentence.
